wants.says: The visitor understands the budgeting app's unique features and benefits.
The visitor feels the budgeting app is tailored to their personal financial situation.
The visitor believes the budgeting app can help them achieve their financial goals.

lines.line: Create a sales page layout with equal-sized blocks for each feature of the budgeting app, clearly highlighting the unique benefits.
Produce a short video showing two identical financial scenarios, one with the budgeting app and one without, to demonstrate the app's impact on personal financial situations.
Embed a video on the sales page that showcases real data from the budgeting app, stating 'no data' where applicable, to build trust in the app's accuracy.
Design a clean, uncluttered interface for the sales page that guides users through the sign-up process for a trial of the budgeting app.
Implement a corporate design style on the sales page to convey a sense of reliability and professionalism for the budgeting app.
Create a series of short videos that link to a longer, more detailed video explaining the benefits of the budgeting app, encouraging users to watch and sign up for a trial.
Use a crane shot in a video to show the detailed features of the budgeting app and then pull back to reveal how these features fit into the overall financial planning process.
Apply a warm, inviting color scheme to the sales page to make the budgeting app feel approachable and user-friendly.
Integrate a Bento-style layout on the sales page and embed a video showing two identical financial scenarios, one with the budgeting app, to highlight the app's unique benefits and personal impact.

Embed two videos on the sales page: one showing real data from the budgeting app and another demonstrating the app's impact on personal financial situations with identical scenarios.
Design a corporate-style sales page with a clean, uncluttered interface to convey reliability and guide users through the sign-up process for a trial of the budgeting app.
